info.title: MICROSERVICE_PROD_Terminal Lifecycle Management API
info.description: The Terminal Lifecycle Management API provides businesses with the ability to manage terminal records effectively. This endpoint allows for the removal of specific terminal instances by their unique identifier, optimizing terminal inventory and resource allocation. Common users of this API include system administrators and operational teams tasked with maintaining terminal networks. By utilizing this API, organizations can ensure that their terminal assets are up-to-date and relevant, enhancing operational efficiency.

delete.summary: Remove a terminal by its ID
delete.description: This operation allows the user to permanently delete a terminal identified by its unique ID. Once deleted, the terminal cannot be recovered.

requestBody.description: This request body is used to provide parameters for the deletion of a specific terminal identified by the ID 'RES-100045'. The request should include necessary information required for the operation to be successful.

204.description: The resource has been successfully deleted with no content returned.

DeleteTerminalByIdRequest.description: This schema represents the request body for the DELETE operation on terminals. It is a simple string value.
